description: The exact index compiler \(\tau(d,e)=\#\operatorname{subst}(c_d,c_e)\) retains leaf indices below \(4\), sends \(4\) to \(d\), and commutes with the actual code constructors \(C_{\rm pair}(p,q)=5+4\langle p,q\rangle\), \(C_{\rm prec}(p,q)=6+4\langle p,q\rangle\), \(C_{\rm comp}(p,q)=7+4\langle p,q\rangle\), and \(C_{\rm find}(p)=8+4p\).
